name: marketing-reviewer
description: Marketing copy compliance reviewer: 9 dimensions, 34 rules, outputs risk-graded Excel and visual HTML report.

displayDescription.en: Scans marketing copy with 9 dimensions and 34 rules, flags ad-law and privacy risks, outputs graded Excel and HTML report.
displayDescription.zh: 9维度34条规则扫描营销文案，定位广告法与隐私合规风险，输出分级Excel与HTML审查报告。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请帮我审查这份营销文案的合规性，识别法律风险并提供修改建议。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please help me review this marketing copy for compliance, identify legal risks, and provide modification suggestions.

quickPrompts.zh: 请帮我审查这份营销文案的合规性，识别法律风险并提供修改建议。

quickPrompts.zh: 审查这份活动文案是否有奖品设置和概率公示方面的合规问题
